test_title: PYST 36: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 28 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Seven boxes, A, B, C, D, M, N and O, are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. Only three boxes are kept above C. Only one box is kept between O and C. Only three boxes are kept between O and N. N is kept at some place above C. A is kept immediately below N. B is kept at one of the places above D. M is not kept immediately above or below O.

Which box is kept at the lowermost position?
solution:
Given: Seven boxes, A, B, C, D, M, N and O, are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

1) Only three boxes are kept above C.

2) Only one box is kept between O and C.

3) Only three boxes are kept between O and N.

4) N is kept at some place above C. 

5) A is kept immediately below N.

6) B
